title: Los Angeles Equestrian Center – Approval of Proposed Amendment No. 2 to
text:
Los Angeles Equestrian Center – Approval of Proposed Amendment No. 2 to
  Agreement No. 3947; Categorical Exemption from the Provisions of the
  California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) Pursuant to Article 19, Section
  15301 [Operation, Repair, Maintenance, Permitting, Leasing, Licensing, or Minor
  Alteration of Existing Public or Private Structures, Facilities, Mechanical

  Equipment, or Topographical Features, Involving Negligible or No Expansion of
  Existing or Former Use] of California CEQA Guidelines as well as Article III,
  Section 1, Class 1(14) of City CEQA Guidelines
